title: WPMS/2059/2020 of RAJPAL SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2059 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Tanuj K. Semwal, Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
Petitioners are resident of Village
Dalupuri, Block Bahadrabad, District
Haridwar, who want to be part of Gram
Panchayat Samaspur Katewar, which has
been constituted vide notification dated
14.10.2020.
By means of this writ petition,
petitioners have sought the following
reliefs:-
(i) Issue a writ order or direction in the
nature of Certiorari quashing the
impugned notification dated 14.10.2020
(Annexure-4) issued by District
Magistrate Haridwar, to the content it
does not include Village Dalupuri, Block
Bahadrabad District Haridwar with the
newly constituted gram Panchayat
Samaspur Katewar.
(ii) Issue a writ order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondents to issue fresh
notification/delimitation list by including
Village Dalupuri, Block Bahadrabad
District Haridwar with the newly
constituted Gram Panchayat Samaspur
Kotewar.
A perusal of notification dated
14.10.2020 indicates that objections were
invited against tentative delimitation
notified on 30.09.2020 and time for filing
objection was given to all the persons
between 01.10.2020 to 06.10.2020.

Learned counsel for the State
submits that petitioners' had not filed any
objection within the stipulated time, which
fact is also admitted to petitioners' counsel.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, learned counsel
for the petitioners submits that petitioner
had filed objection on 12.09.2020 and
13.10.2020.
Since petitioners' had not filed any
objection between 01.10.2020 to
06.10.2020, therefore, the decision taken
by District Magistrate, Haridwar, which
was notified on 14.10.2020, cannot be
faulted. Thus, this Court finds no merit in
the writ petition. Accordingly, writ petition
fails and is hereby dismissed.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Aswal 02.11.2020
